name: Federico Long
headline: Client Manager at Oracle Managed Cloud Services
about:
Goal oriented professional maintaining a high level of attention to current responsibilities. Strong focus on internal/external customer satisfaction balanced with company goals while strictly adhering to company policies and ethics.

Outstanding negotiation skills acquired throughout more than 20 years of field experience on technology project management; building and leading high skilled professional teams for supporting core business strategy.

Strong minded leadership approach, providing direction and motivation to team mates.

Worked for customers within a variety of industries; including manufacturing, pharmaceutical, construction, financial sector (banks), energy sector (mainly petroleoum companies) and communications sector. Understanding and supporting the core business strategy as a mean to provide value-added solutions.

Throughout my professional career, roles assumed include project management, architectural design, system analysis, support strategy, systems administration, infrastructure administration, system security, training,

Consistently engaging in higher levels of responsibility and positively contributing toward the professional growth of fellow team members. 

Excellent level of English: listening, reading and writing.

Specialties: Management:
Negotiation skills
Planning skills
Strategy design, plan building and execution/follow-up skills
Build and drive teams focused on clear business objectives
Setup, discuss, negotiate /support budget and execute accordingly

Technical:
ERP knowledge from business implementation standpoint.
Development Cycle methodologies
Technology integration knowledge
Skilled in Software Systems Design & Technology Solution Architecture
Excellent knowledge of RDBMS : Microsoft SQL Server & Sybase
